source: ICES Ocean Hydrochemistry: bottle and low-resolution CTD
citation: ICES Data Portal, Dataset on Ocean Hydrochemistry, extracted November 3, 2026. ICES, Copenhagen. CC BY 4.0.
method: Quality flag QV:ODV=0 only. Mean within each cast at 0–1 m, then day, then year-month, then equal weight across available years. Two main-channel station seasonal means weighted by inverse distance squared. No temporal filling. All grid values are spatial estimates, not measurements.
limitations: Historical seasonal reference, not 2025/2026 salinity. Two stations cannot resolve local shoreline, channel or island effects. A 100 m display grid does not mean 100 m source accuracy. Recent western observations are separate and include unknown quality (ODV=1). Practical salinity is dimensionless, not directly absolute salinity in g/kg.

independentHistoricalCheck.note: Six overlapping calendar-month seasonal means at a third historical location; not a present-day or whole-grid validation.
